hero.eidText: May Allah accept your fasting, your prayers and your good deeds.
hero.offText: Your Ramadan companion will activate 30 days before the blessed month begins.

times.title: Today's times
times.noLocation: Set your location on the home screen to display the times.

dua.title: Dua for breaking the fast
dua.before: To say when breaking the fast
dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma laka ṣumtu, wa bika āmantu, wa ʿalayka tawakkaltu, wa ʿalā rizqika afṭartu.
dua.translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted, in You I have believed, in You I have placed my trust, and with Your provision I break my fast.
dua.arabic2: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration2: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓamaʾu wabtallatil-ʿurūqu wa thabatal-ajru in shāʾa Allāh.
dua.translation2: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

offset.title: Start date
offset.description: The start of Ramadan depends on moon sighting in your country. Shift the date if needed.

fasting.title: My fasting
fasting.lockedPast: Editing other days and making up missed fasts is a Premium feature.
fasting.privacy: The reason for an exemption is never saved.

khatm.title: Khatm plan
khatm.intro: Read the whole Quran during Ramadan. Your daily portion adapts to your pace.
khatm.behind: You are {{n}} juz behind: today's portion has been adjusted.
khatm.planDone: MashaAllah! You completed your reading goal. 🎉
khatm.confirmReset: The current plan and your reading progress will be deleted so you can create a new one. Continue?
khatm.startInfo: Your plan starts on {{date}}. Each day, the app will show you the portion of the Quran to read (about {{n}} juz per day): you can open it directly in the Quran and then mark it as done.
khatm.reminderInfo: A reminder will be sent every day at {{time}}.

worship.title: Tarawih and sadaqah
worship.tarawihHint: Tick each night you prayed tarawih (or stood in night prayer). Tap a circle to change it.
worship.sadaqaHint: Tick each day you gave sadaqah, even something small: a smile, a gift, a shared meal.

lastTen.title: The last 10 nights
lastTen.oddTonight: ✨ Tonight is night {{n}}, an odd night: look for Laylat al-Qadr.
lastTen.eidNight: Ramadan is coming to an end. May Allah accept your deeds.
lastTen.hint: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months. Look for it in the odd nights: prayer, Quran and supplication.
lastTen.duaArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عُفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
lastTen.duaTransliteration: Allāhumma innaka ʿafuwwun tuḥibbul-ʿafwa faʿfu ʿannī.
lastTen.duaTranslation: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon: so pardon me.
